Package org.apache.turbine.services.pull.util

Class DateTimeFormatterTool

java.lang.Object
org.apache.turbine.services.pull.util.DateFormatter
org.apache.turbine.services.pull.util.DateTimeFormatterTool
All Implemented Interfaces:
DateTimeFormatterInterface, ApplicationTool
public class DateTimeFormatterTool extends DateFormatter implements DateTimeFormatterInterface
This pull tool is used to format TemporalAccessor and map(String, DateTimeFormatter, Locale) (different flavors) objects into strings. This tool extends DateFormatter to simplify configuration and to allow legacy Date inputs. The methods may throw UnsupportedTemporalTypeException or DateTimeParseException. if the source and the target format do not match appropriately.

  • Method Details

    • init

      public void init(Object data)
      Initialize the application tool. The data parameter holds a different type depending on how the tool is being instantiated:
      • For global tools data will be null
      • For request tools data will be of type RunData
      • For session and persistent tools data will be of type User
      the getDefaultFormat() from getFormatPattern() with DateTimeFormatterService.getLocale() and zoneId DateTimeFormatterService.getZoneId() is used. Customizations: Locale could be fetched from request, if #USE_REQUEST_LOCALE_KEY is set to true (by default it is false.Then it will be retrieved either from RundataLocalizationService.getLocale(RunData) (if set in urbien role configuration) or LocalizationService.getLocale(jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest).
      Specified by:
